title: Construct the first successful finite extension slice from raw pencils
body:
Construct the least successful finite extension and an actual invertible projective slice from raw regular square matrices A,B, without enumerating all irreducibles through the degree threshold. Return an explicit field modulus, point, literal tA+B (or infinity A) and a two-sided inverse. This takes [PR6451's first open question](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/6451), pinned at e9548573ead05bbecaaa6e194f9f8298d9a6923a; its sharp threshold and attaining pencils remain Nick Petalas's results.

The written algorithm works for every supplied exact Fq representation. Polynomial Bareiss extracts f(t). Infinity and the base field are handled explicitly. Sequential Frobenius gcds identify the first degree e; the missing-root quotient then has only degree-e factors, so one-branch classical Berlekamp splitting obtains a modulus. Previous failure gives q^(e−1)<=deg f<=n−1 and q<n, hence q^e< n² in the dense branch. The large-q branch stops after at most n+1 base trials and never allocates degree-q data. PROOF.md supplies minimality, literal construction, storage/enumeration requests and a conservative O(n^8 log n) base-field operation bound, including determinant extraction, gcds, splitting and inversion/checks. This is a supplied-field arithmetic result, with base-field inversion a primitive; the reference's Fermat extension-inverse overhead is stated separately and fits the bound. No general factoring algorithm, optimal complexity, runtime improvement or free base-field construction is claimed.

Finite evidence: raw-constructor and blind-first literal-field engines agree on all6920 declared pencil status/degree streams:617 singular,6303 regular;6297 first degree1 and six degree2. Domains are all F2 dimensions0–2, F3 dimensions1–2, F5 dimension1, and binary dimension3 DIAGONAL pencils only. Dimension0 is a calibration outside the n>=1 theorem. The separate oracle directly validates all17 actual named primary moduli, points, matrices and BOTH inverse products, permitting different valid moduli. It does not recheck every census inverse. Named cases exercise first degrees2/3/4, source-attaining raw/scrambled pencils, infinity-only success, nonmonotone degree3 success/degree4 failure, row pivots and q1,000,003 with constant determinant. The fixed large prime was checked by999 trial divisors through1000. The reference API is q in {2,3,5,1000003},0<=n<=17; it does not implement nonprime base fields.

Both first and final normal/optimized emission/strict runs pass with empty stderr, per-engine receipts byte-identical. Primary17controls comprise12actual rejections and5computed positive boundary checks; oracle has5actual rejections and computed boundary controls. Ten external optimized corruption checks reject. Registered replay,15 committed-file bytes/modes and declared canonical-base provenance, official export integrity and four read-only Git-free/empty-PATH replays pass unchanged. Public head `0a389a6cf4a267faa8d253e9ee610be454f78491` has exactly tested/exported tree `d809e8d22a6edae6094ae3a90e3b7300f1e29f66`. First blind code/receipts are preserved; oracle's post-first change only hardens peer provenance labels. Static review corrected an omitted n-dependence in a gcd cost term and documented the Fermat-reference difference before freeze, without changing scientific inputs or receipts. Both hosted jobs passed at this exact head in [run41577716955](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/41577716955):711 helper tests and the registered package replay. Completed logs were read once; run metadata matches the head and the synthetic test tree equals the public/tested/exported tree. No actual merge.

Reproduce: CPython3.12 standard library,
`python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/pencil-first-slice-constructor`.
Direct runs measure0.5–1.1seconds here; no timing gate or performance comparison. Both inert6451documents and PENCILS.json authenticate before parsing. No predecessor scientific program or census is imported/run. Finite checks corroborate the written all-prime-power argument, rather than establish it. Separate AI implementation/static review is not independent human or formal-kernel acceptance.
